title: Sovereign green bonds: a catalyst for sustainable debt market development?
summary: This BIS Working Paper (No. 1198) examines whether sovereign green bond issuance catalyzes corporate sustainable bond market development. Using regression and event study analysis on a database of labelled bonds, the authors find that sovereign green bond issuance leads to increased corporate sustainable bond issuance (both number and size), with stronger effects in jurisdictions with stronger climate policies. The paper also documents improvements in green disclosure and verification standards after sovereign debut, and finds evidence of greater liquidity and diminished yield spreads in corporate green bonds—though the liquidity and spread effects are limited to the debut sovereign green bond issue.
key_points: Sovereign green bond issuance results in increased corporate sustainable bond issuance in terms of both number and size of deals
The corporate issuance increase is more pronounced in countries with stronger climate policies
Sovereign green bond issuance improves the quality of green disclosure and verification standards in the corporate bond market
The debut sovereign green bond issue increases liquidity and diminishes yield spreads of corporate green bonds in the same jurisdiction
The liquidity and spread effects are limited to the debut sovereign issue, not subsequent sovereign issuance
The paper constructs a database including variables on size, reporting, verification, pricing, and liquidity of green and labelled bonds
Authors: Gong Cheng, Torsten Ehlers, Frank Packer, and Yanzhe Xiao; published July 12, 2024
why_it_matters: For bond market participants, this research quantifies how sovereign green bond benchmarks can bootstrap private sustainable bond markets. Sovereign issuers considering green bond programs can expect spillover effects on corporate issuance and market infrastructure, while corporate issuers benefit from improved verification standards. Investors and policymakers can use these findings to understand how public sector leadership accelerates sustainable finance market development.
market_structure_context: The paper examines sustainable bond market development dynamics, specifically how sovereign issuance benchmarks influence corporate bond market growth, liquidity, pricing, and reporting standards. While related to bond market structure in a broad sense, the focus is on market development rather than market microstructure or plumbing.
